title: ProductJoinTicket
description: Narrow, signed, short-lived Cloud assertion authorizing one eligible account to request daemon membership for one Product. Carries only the minimum bounded claims. additionalProperties is false: the daemon fails closed on any claim outside this set. It never carries the full hosted (Supabase) session token, refresh tokens, roles, or membership assertions. See docs/specs/domain-product-onboarding-contract.md.

issuer.description: Hosted issuer identity (who minted the ticket).

audience.description: Intended daemon audience for the ticket.

product_id.description: Canonical Product the ticket authorizes a join request for.

verified_domain.description: Verified identity domain for same-domain eligibility.

nonce.description: Single-use nonce / JTI for replay detection.

registration_ref.description: Opaque reference the daemon uses to correlate the directory row; not canonical settings.

provider_hint.description: Optional safe provider hint for setup routing.

substrate_hint.description: Optional safe event-store substrate hint for setup routing.
